**Finding: deviation (§ 14.10 Assignment, p0188)** — redline validated and submitted.

- **Issue:** The restriction is one-way. We need IBM's consent to assign, with a narrow successor carve-out (merger, consolidation or acquisition only — no affiliate or sale-of-assets carve-out), while IBM's ability to assign is wholly unrestricted, with no consent requirement and no bar on assignment to one of our competitors. That asymmetry fails even the fallback, which requires mutuality and a reasonable-consent standard.
- **Fix (preferred position, one sentence):** carve out assignments to affiliates and to successors by merger, consolidation, acquisition or sale of substantially all assets; and subject IBM's assignment to our prior written consent (not unreasonably withheld), never to a Customer competitor.
- **Not flagged:** there is no change-of-control provision anywhere in the Agreement and no IBM termination or re-pricing right on our change of control, so no walk-away trigger; IBM's § 14.8 subcontracting right is left intact.
